architecture.pipeline_map: USER_QUERY → QUERY_EMBEDDING (embeddingService) → VECTOR_RETRIEVAL (ragService) → CANDIDATES (r6c2Builder) → EVIDENCE_LAYER (MISSING: Grouper, Validator, Sufficiency, Packet) → ANSWER_GENERATION (auraToolExecutor) → PROVENANCE (MISSING: claim-level trace)

EvidenceGroup.rule: Más chunks ≠ mejor evidencia. Grupo solo si cobertura de claims aumenta

completeness.missing: IMPLEMENTATION — all three contracts defined but no code exists

cabello_002.query: Rutina para cabello teñido con pH bajo y pérdida de elasticidad

analysis.retrieval_miss: Gold chunks rank >100, sim 0.31-0.34 vs hard negatives 0.65+
analysis.evidence_composition: Builder creates correct category candidate but with wrong chunks (not gold)
analysis.generation_impact: If passed to generator, would cite non-gold chunks from correct category
analysis.root_cause: Embedding drift — gold chunks exist but displaced by hard negatives

cejas_008.query: Tratamiento láser para eliminación de microblading en cejas

analysis.retrieval_miss: Gold chunks rank >50, sim 0.34-0.49 vs hard negatives 0.76+
analysis.evidence_composition: Builder creates correct category candidate but with non-gold chunks
analysis.generation_impact: Would cite related domain chunks, not the specific laser removal evidence
analysis.root_cause: Embedding drift + hard negative contamination (cabello dominates)

cejas_004.query: Corrección de cejas asimétricas con micropigmentación

analysis.retrieval_miss: VECTOR_MISS — Gold chunks rank >100, sim 0.34-0.45 vs hard negatives 0.75+
analysis.evidence_composition: Builder creates correct category candidate but ZERO gold chunks included
analysis.generation_impact: Highest risk — would produce answer with NO gold evidence, potential false SUFFICIENT
analysis.root_cause: Deep embedding drift — all 4 core pieces displaced; R5-C27 confirmed 4/6 pieces outside top-100

vector_retrieval_ceiling.definition: Maximum recall achievable by vector retrieval alone (top-100)
vector_retrieval_ceiling.evidence_from_R6_RECOVERY_3: Gold-wide: 12/15 VECTOR-DRIFT (rank >50), 3/15 EXPECTED-MISS (top-50 but not top-5)

evidence_availability_ceiling.definition: Maximum recall if ALL chunks with similarity >0.3 were available (evidence exists in corpus)
evidence_availability_ceiling.note: R6-RECOVERY-3 sanity test shows expected > random (margin +0.05 to +0.15), suggesting evidence exists but ranked low. Requires full corpus scan to compute true ceiling.

aggregation_ceiling.definition: Maximum recall if Evidence Grouper perfectly combines all relevant chunks per query
aggregation_ceiling.note: R5-C23 evidence ceiling @100 = 0.9333 (14/15 answerable), but that was on HISTORICAL vectors. On current vectors, unknown. Requires experiment.

answerability_ceiling.definition: Maximum queries answerable with SUFFICIENT evidence after full Evidence Layer
answerability_ceiling.note: Depends on Sufficiency Gate calibration. R5-C28 gate strong_score ≥0.55 reduced false SUFFICIENT but had 3 regressions. Not yet tested on R6 space.

unsupported_differentiation.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: Evidencia existe pero no alcanza cobertura/gate (cejas_004: 4/6 piezas fuera pool)
unsupported_differentiation.RETRIEVAL_UNCERTAIN: No se distingue gap de miss

unsupported_policy.generator_behavior: En modo corpus-grounded, NO completa con conocimiento externo. Responde declarando insuficiencia + motivo trazable.

gate_strong_score_055.valid_after_rebaseline: UNVERIFIED — gate was calibrated on historical vectors; effectiveness on R6 space unknown
gate_strong_score_055.note: R6-C4 baseline R@5=0.0000 suggests most queries have no chunks ≥0.55; gate may be too strict for new space

false_sufficient_risk.case: cejas_004 in R5-C26: Evidence Aggregator declared SUFFICIENT with precision=0 (false positive)
false_sufficient_risk.current_status: Evidence Candidate Builder does not have sufficiency logic; risk persists for R6-C3

Retrieval.reason: ragService.searchBeautyKnowledge intact, HNSW operational, FTS fallback works. No changes needed.

Candidate_representation.reason: EvidenceCandidate structure (candidate_id, chunk_ids, category, titles, retrieval_scores, evidence_text, provenance, candidate_score, evidence_count, confidence_signals) is well-defined and useful for EvidencePacket.

Evidence_grouping.reason: Current grouping by metadata.category is simplistic. Needs semantic clustering (embedding similarity) + complementarity detection. Keep structure, replace algorithm.

Deduplication.reason: R6-C1 documented 5 duplicate chunk_ids in BD. R6-C2 builder does NOT deduplicate cross-category. Required in Grouper.

Evidence_scoring.reason: Current candidate_score = lead chunk similarity. Insufficient for sufficiency. Needs composite: coverage + gate + consistency + redundancy penalty.

Sufficiency.reason: No sufficiency logic in R6-C2. Contract defined in R6-C1 (6 dimensions + gate 0.55). Must be implemented in R6-C3.

Provenance.reason: R6-C2 provenance object (source, retrieval_count, categories_represented, max/min/spread score) is complete and traces back to vector retrieval. Extend for grouper/packet.

Unsupported.reason: R6-C2 has no unsupported logic. Policy defined in R6-C1 (3 subtypes). Required for EvidencePacket.

Answer_packet.reason: No EvidencePacket produced. Contract defined in R6-C1. Required to replace raw chunks in auraToolExecutor.

SUFFICIENCY.missing: Full sufficiency model (coverage, relevance, complementarity, consistency, redundancy, gate≥0.55)

ANSWER_GENERATION.current_behavior: Returns raw chunks {status: success, knowledge: results}
ANSWER_GENERATION.required: Accept EvidencePacket, generate grounded answer with claim tracing

PROVENANCE.missing: Evidence-level provenance, claim→evidence trace, state logging

excessive_embedding_score_dependency.evidence: R6-C2 candidate_score = lead chunk similarity; skincare dominates top-1 in 11/15 non-skincare queries; hard negatives score 0.65-0.76 vs gold 0.31-0.49
excessive_embedding_score_dependency.impact: Builder promotes high-score hard negatives over lower-score gold evidence

topk_dependency.evidence: Builder only sees top-50 retrieval; gold chunks for critical cases rank >100; increasing K helps but at latency/cost tradeoff
topk_dependency.impact: Evidence ceiling bounded by retrieval K

hard_negative_contamination.evidence: Skincare chunks dominate top ranks across categories; R6-C2 candidates show skincare as top-1 in 11/15 queries
hard_negative_contamination.impact: Cross-category contamination reduces diversity; gold categories buried

evidence_redundancy.evidence: R6-C2 max 3 chunks/category, no cross-category dedup; same chunk could appear in multiple candidates if metadata allows

contradictory_evidence.evidence: R6-C1 contract includes 'contradictory' field in EvidenceGroup; not detected in R6-C2
contradictory_evidence.impact: Contradictory chunks could be grouped, reducing answer quality

insufficient_declared_sufficient.evidence: R5-C26 false SUFFICIENT (cejas_004: precision=0); R5-C28 gate 0.55 helped but caused 3 regressions; R6-C2 has no sufficiency
insufficient_declared_sufficient.impact: Without Sufficiency Gate, R6-C3 could repeat false positives

corpus_gap_vs_retrieval_miss_confusion.evidence: R6-C4: 12/15 VECTOR-DRIFT (retrieval miss), 0 CORPUS-GAP; but R5-C27 found 3 CORPUS-GAP. On new vectors, classification harder.
corpus_gap_vs_retrieval_miss_confusion.impact: Misattribution could drive wrong fixes (corpus vs retrieval)

recommended_next_experiment.name: R6-C3 — Evidence Aggregator Experimental
recommended_next_experiment.hypothesis: Un Evidence Aggregator operando sobre los candidatos estructurados por el Builder puede componer EvidencePackets con suficiencia semántica, resolviendo los misses multi-chunk (cabello_002, cejas_008) manteniendo precision, sin requerir cambios al espacio vectorial.
recommended_next_experiment.input: EvidenceCandidates from R6-C2 Builder (9.6 avg candidates/query, 1.71 chunks/candidate, provenance complete)
components_to_build: Evidence Grouper: cluster candidates by semantic complementarity (embedding similarity + claim coverage), not just category
Deduplication: remove duplicate/overlapping chunks across candidates (address 5 known duplicate chunk_ids + cross-category)
Evidence Validator: detect contradictions, filter hard negatives (skincare dominance), score consistency
Sufficiency Gate: implement 6-dimension model (coverage + gate≥0.55 + consistency + complementarity + redundancy + relevance)
Evidence Packet: assemble authorized evidence + state + confidence + provenance + constraints

evaluation.comparison: Control = R6-C2 Builder output vs Experiment = Aggregator output

constraints: RUN A ≡ RUN B reproducibility required
No LLM-as-judge for evidence quality (use Gold-V5)

success_criteria.R6_C3_AGGREGATOR_CONFIRMED: Evidence Recall @20 ≥ 0.33 AND False SUFFICIENT = 0 AND cabello_002 → SUPPORTED
success_criteria.R6_C3_AGGREGATOR_MIXED: Improvement on multi-chunk cases but cejas_004 unresolved OR false SUFFICIENT > 0
success_criteria.R6_C3_AGGREGATOR_DISCONFIRMED: No improvement over R6-C2 Builder or regression in precision
